summary: Replace the live ReloadTorpedoes all-barrel loop with the single reconstructed 004646B0 body over the actual gun row and its existing timer writer.

counts.note: Readiness is a source-text metric; call_graph counts entry-reachable reconstructed addresses. Runtime execution was not sampled.

implementation: GunReloadResetHost narrows the former Seg5Host/raw-layout boundary to the actual barrel count and timer setter; no duplicate address body or synthetic gun image is added.
The native listing at 004646B6/D3 reloads gun+448h and 004646C0..CB calls 0072CF00 in ascending barrel order with +0.0f and flags zero. The body retains those operations through the narrow provider.

GameGunneryHost::fixed_step consumes the existing ReloadTorpedoes queue, produced by the real script binding in game_hosts_script_orders.cpp. The adapter borrows that same GameGunRow, barrel_num and fire.barrel_timers; the producer sizes the timer vector from barrel_num.
The existing modified-barrel counter, category-8 powerup query and barrel_reload_write_0072cf00 call run once per barrel. The untouched previous loop is the switch-OFF arm.
The existing 0072CF00 semantic writer omits its effect-spawn tail; this change preserves that established boundary and does not claim new coverage for 0072CF00.
